question: Should this narrow provider diagnostics guard be the canonical branch, or should maintainers fold it into a broader sibling such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89119 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89141 before merge?
rationale: The code change is plausible, but the PR is maintainer-labeled, conflicting, and overlaps same-surface hardening drafts, so automation should not choose the permanent scope or landing branch.

options.title: Choose and rebase one canonical branch
options.body: Pick the branch whose scope should land, fold in any desired sibling behavior, and rebase it onto current main before merge.

options.title: Land this narrow guard deliberately
options.body: Refresh this PR and land only the diagnostic-field and tool-name guard while leaving inspector-failure and broader schema hardening to separate follow-up work.

options.title: Retire after a broader sibling lands
options.body: If a broader diagnostics branch lands the same useful behavior, close this PR as superseded by that merged branch.

recommendation.title: Choose and rebase one canonical branch
recommendation.body: Pick the branch whose scope should land, fold in any desired sibling behavior, and rebase it onto current main before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns this PR and the linked overlapping drafts, making them the clearest person to choose or consolidate the branch scope.
